associations.rationale: The displayed type concludes solvability from a group order of the form p^a q^b; it is a consequence of the proof discussion, not the source claim's Sylow-theoretic conjugacy-class versus center alternative.

The displayed type derives a proper nontrivial normal subgroup from an already assumed positive prime-power conjugacy-class size, but it does not state that Sylow theory produces such a class or the alternative involving the center.
